cells.gaps: No total of councils is stated, so the two councils named as recording (Basse, and Kanifing's property rates database) are counts without a denominator. The April 2026 evaluation says Basse 'will embark on' the system, against two ministry reports that it operates one with a digital tax register; Janjanbureh and Brikama have none. A June 2026 tender for a property tax system for Kanifing is procured by a UN agency, and its award is not held; no plan is held inside 36 months.
cells.note: A register is live in a council outside the capital, held in the council's own system. Stage 4 needs more than half of councils on a share or a count with a denominator, and the evidence names one or two with no total.
